Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action, drug_mechanism.action_type, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno. drug_mechanism.tid = target_dictionary.tid. molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. drug_mechanism.action_type = 'INHIBITOR'. Sort: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC. Limit: None.
